3 · THE GAP & WHY -12.85% BNCI-001
Original Authors' Code / Protocol Root Cause

ARCHITECTURAL FLAW in CorNet: Projecting Σ↦D−1/2ΣD−1/2\Sigma \mapsto D^{-1/2} \Sigma D^{-1/2}Σ↦D−1/2ΣD−1/2 onto C++n\mathcal{C}_{++}^nC++n​ and extracting only the strict lower triangle (tril_embed of size n(n−1)/2n(n-1)/2n(n−1)/2) **destroys all diagonal variance**. On 3-channel BNCI2014-004 (C3, Cz, C4), where contralateral C3/C4 power is the primary motor imagery signal, only (32)=3\binom{3}{2}=3(23​)=3 numbers remain!

Our spd_learn Code / Harness Fix

Even after fixing frozen shrinkage (init_shrinkage=-5.0), CorNet's hollow correlation projection collapses on variance-driven tasks in Voyager: **58.41±15.7958.41 \pm 15.7958.41±15.79%** on BNCI2014-001, **62.54±10.2662.54 \pm 10.2662.54±10.26%** on 3-ch BNCI2014-004 (-17.54% behind STaRNet 80.08%), **88.99±1.8788.99 \pm 1.8788.99±1.87%** on 40×4040\times 4040×40 Radar (-8.66% behind ALEM), and **58.39±1.3858.39 \pm 1.3858.39±1.38%** on HDM05 (-13.29% behind SPDNetBN).

Dataloader & Preprocessing Diff

Paper primarily benchmarks 200-ROI fMRI functional connectivity (ABIDE, where correlation is standard and CorNet reaches 61.75%); applying CorNet to EEG motor imagery, Radar, or Skeletal SPD destroys diagonal power.

Where It Fails / Struggles

Severe collapse across all power-driven benchmarks: worst model on 3-channel BNCI2014-004 (62.54%), worst on 40×4040\times 4040×40 Radar (88.99% vs 97.65%), and -11.15% behind GraphCSPNet on BNCI2014-001 (58.41%).

Paper Overview & Mathematical Spec Riemannian Networks over Full-Rank Correlation Matrices (ICML 2026) 4 Figures · 12 Paper Tables · 4 Voyager Benchmarks
Paper Abstract & Core Formulation

Full-rank correlation matrices provide scale-invariant functional connectivity representations in neuroimaging. We develop Riemannian neural networks over the correlation manifold (CorNet) under quotient and pullback metrics (OLM and LSM), preserving unit-diagonal positive definiteness across deep bilinear and non-linear transformations.

Deep-Dive Root-Cause Attribution (Original Authors' Code vs. Our Code), Failure Modes & Practitioner Guidance

Original Authors' Code / Protocol Root CauseARCHITECTURAL FLAW in CorNet: Projecting Σ↦D−1/2ΣD−1/2\Sigma \mapsto D^{-1/2} \Sigma D^{-1/2}Σ↦D−1/2ΣD−1/2 onto C++n\mathcal{C}_{++}^nC++n​ and extracting only the strict lower triangle (tril_embed of size n(n−1)/2n(n-1)/2n(n−1)/2) **destroys all diagonal variance**. On 3-channel BNCI2014-004 (C3, Cz, C4), where contralateral C3/C4 power is the primary motor imagery signal, only (32)=3\binom{3}{2}=3(23​)=3 numbers remain!
Our spd_learn Code / Harness Fix AppliedEven after fixing frozen shrinkage (init_shrinkage=-5.0), CorNet's hollow correlation projection collapses on variance-driven tasks in Voyager: **58.41±15.7958.41 \pm 15.7958.41±15.79%** on BNCI2014-001, **62.54±10.2662.54 \pm 10.2662.54±10.26%** on 3-ch BNCI2014-004 (-17.54% behind STaRNet 80.08%), **88.99±1.8788.99 \pm 1.8788.99±1.87%** on 40×4040\times 4040×40 Radar (-8.66% behind ALEM), and **58.39±1.3858.39 \pm 1.3858.39±1.38%** on HDM05 (-13.29% behind SPDNetBN).
Dataloader & Preprocessing DiffPaper primarily benchmarks 200-ROI fMRI functional connectivity (ABIDE, where correlation is standard and CorNet reaches 61.75%); applying CorNet to EEG motor imagery, Radar, or Skeletal SPD destroys diagonal power.
Architecture & Optimizer Diffspd_learn implements CorNet (CovToCorr + BiMap + log_map_olm/lsm + tril_embed of size n(n−1)/2n(n-1)/2n(n−1)/2) with learnable shrinkage.
Where It Struggles / DivergesSevere collapse across all power-driven benchmarks: worst model on 3-channel BNCI2014-004 (62.54%), worst on 40×4040\times 4040×40 Radar (88.99% vs 97.65%), and -11.15% behind GraphCSPNet on BNCI2014-001 (58.41%).
Primary Mathematical Failure ModeWhen a temporal Conv2d layer with non-zero bias precedes CovLayer in raw-signal mode, channel-wise amplitude scaling alters the bias-to-signal ratio before correlation projection.
Silent Diagnostic RiskTesting scale invariance on raw time series without zero-bias spatial/temporal filtering breaks exact diagonal congruence DSDD S DDSD invariance.
Practitioner RecommendationUse input_type='cov' or set bias=False in preceding temporal convolutions when strict invariance to multiplicative channel gain is required.
